title: STARK: Moving towards Personalized Agents That Truly Learn and Remember
title_zh: STARK：迈向真正能学习与记忆的个性化智能体
abstract_en: Long-term memory is essential for personalized agentic systems that interact with users over long time periods, yet current architectures only capture what happened while leaving the reasoning of why it happened to be derived later by underlying LLMs.%, and silo knowledge within individual users. These events can, however, convey not only what a user experienced but also how that experience shaped their behavioral patterns. We introduce STARK, a dual-graph memory architecture which treats these events not just as nodes but also as edges between behavioral insights. STARK maintains an Episodic Graph which records interactions as temporally, causally, and semantically linked episodes; and an Insight Graph which represents LLM-extracted behavioral signals scored by how many events support them, connected by the very events that led to them. At inference, behavioral knowledge is retrieved directly from insight nodes grounded by event-as-edges, eliminating repeated episodic traversal. The event-as-edge structure also naturally enables projecting the knowledge graph into a relational embedding space where cross-user transfer becomes possible under shared contextual circumstances, allowing the system to infer missing insights for cold-start users. Evaluations show that STARK improves by 1.48 judge score on LongMemEval information extraction and 0.93 on LoCoMo open domain questions over state of the art. On the public LongLaMP abstract-generation benchmark, cross-user transfer improves open-ended judge scores by 0.7 points and ROUGE-L by 3 at 5% graph sparsity.
abstract_zh: 长期记忆是个性化智能体持续与用户交互的基础，但现有架构往往只记录发生了什么，把原因和行为规律留给大语言模型（LLM）在推理时重新归纳，并将知识局限在单个用户内部。STARK 提出双图记忆架构：Episodic Graph 按时间、因果和语义关系组织交互事件；Insight Graph 则以 LLM 提取的行为洞察为节点，根据支持事件的数量为洞察评分，并以促成这些洞察的事件作为连接边。这种设计既能在推理时直接检索有事件佐证的行为洞察，避免反复遍历历史交互，也能将知识图谱投影到关系嵌入空间，在情境相似的用户之间迁移知识，为冷启动用户推断缺失的洞察。相比此前最优方法，STARK 在 LongMemEval 信息提取和 LoCoMo 开放域问答上的评审分数分别提升 1.48 和 0.93 分。在公开基准 LongLaMP 的摘要生成任务中，当图稀疏度为 5% 时，跨用户迁移使开放式评审分数提高 0.7 分，ROUGE-L 提高 3 分。
key_points_zh: 同一交互事件承担两种角色：在 Episodic Graph 中是记录历史的节点，在 Insight Graph 中是连接行为洞察的边。
行为洞察由 LLM 提取，并按支持事件的数量评分；推理时可直接检索洞察，无需反复遍历历史交互。
关系嵌入支持在情境相似的用户之间迁移行为洞察，为冷启动用户补全缺失的洞察。
相比此前最优方法，LongMemEval 信息提取与 LoCoMo 开放域问答的评审分数分别提高 1.48 和 0.93 分。
在 LongLaMP 摘要生成任务中，当图稀疏度为 5% 时，跨用户迁移使开放式评审分数提高 0.7 分，ROUGE-L 提高 3 分。

agent-memory.reason: 双图架构将历史交互既存为情节节点，也用作连接行为洞察的边，使智能体在后续交互中可直接检索有事件支撑的洞察，而不必反复遍历情节图。摘要报告了相对现有最佳方法的量化提升，以及低图稀疏度条件下的跨用户迁移收益，但未提供足以隔离各组件作用的消融证据。
